remarks: Ski mornings, Village evenings, and nothing on your to-do list but enjoying both. Built in 2024 and tucked just off Route 219 and easily walkable to the Village of Ellicottville, this fully furnished 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhome on Glen Burn Trail puts Holiday Valley, HoliMont, and the shops, restaurants, and breweries of Washington Street a few minutes from your door. Inside, a 1,626 sq ft two-level layout flows from a welcoming foyer into an open living, dining, and kitchen space anchored by a gas fireplace and finished with solid-surface counters, a gas cooktop, range hood, and a walk-in pantry. First-floor laundry, a half bath, and a dedicated ski-and-bike storage room handle the practical side of mountain living, while patios front and back extend the season outdoors. Upstairs, a 17-foot primary suite offers a double-vanity bath and walk-in shower, two additional bedrooms share a full bath with tub, and a 153 sq ft upper landing works as a den, media nook, or remote office. Central air, forced-air gas heat, and ENERGY STAR qualified appliances, windows, and lighting keep comfort high and utility surprises low, and newer construction versus older condos mean weekends are spent on the slopes, not on maintenance. Two assigned parking spaces, professional HOA management, and a pet-friendly community round out the package. Furnished and turnkey, it's ready to be your year-round home, weekend basecamp, or income-producing retreat in one of Western New York's most sought-after four-season destinations.
